content.title: When and where to watch FC Barcelona v Espanyol
content.text: It's derby time as Espanyol are set to visit the Spotify Camp Nou for the first time in just over three years. It's a always a match filled with emotion and represents the week 31 fixture in LaLiga and another three points will be the order of the day to at least maintain the lead against Real Madrid. The game kicks off at 6.30pm local time and this guide should help you work out what time that will be in your part of the world. If you are unable to watch for whatever reason, or you wish to complement your viewing with second screen info, don’t forget we have full coverage of the game, including the build-up live from the stadium and post-match reactions in our Match Center right here on the official website.
